text:
sam (RevOps): Heads up — saw ~12 inbound leads stuck unassigned overnight, several >30m. Looks like HubSpot -> SF sync dropped assignment events during an enrichment spike. Sharing quick notes.

maria (Marketing Ops): Ugh, that explains the inbox. Any channel/paid vs organic skew?

ajay (SDR): I found 3 in my queue this AM unclaimed, had to manually grab them. No notification came through.

lee (Sales Eng): Probably a race: enrichment webhook to /internal/enrich timed out and rr-assigner never fired. We saw a small window of 502s.

dev-bot: deploy: rr-assigner v2.1 rolled at 03:10 UTC — status: success :white_check_mark:

sam (RevOps): Quick dig: HubSpot workflows still trigger, but the rotation lambda waits for enrichment with a 10s window. Between 02:58-03:22 there were repeated 502s on enrich-service. Logs excerpt: ```
[2026-03-21T02:59:03Z] enrich-service ERROR 502 gateway timeout - POST /enrich 15.2s
[2026-03-21T03:01:10Z] rr-assigner WARN enrichment timeout after 10s for lead 8421
[2026-03-21T03:05:44Z] hs-sync INFO  queued assignment event for lead 8425
[2026-03-21T03:06:12Z] rr-assigner ERROR failed to claim owner - downstream 502
```

maria (Marketing Ops): Proposal: reduce enrichment wait from 10s -> 5s and add immediate fallback to overflow pool when enrichment fails. Also notify SDRs when fallback used.

lee (Sales Eng): Agree. Also add small random jitter to the round-robin to avoid thundering-herd when sync retries happen. Current concurrency burst seems to correlate with the window. Suggest 0-500ms random delay.

ajay (SDR): +1. And can we add a Slack alert to #sales-ops if any lead is unassigned >5m? That would've caught this earlier.

sam (RevOps): Plan: patch rr-assigner with shorter enrichment wait + fallback to overflow, add jitter, and create metric lead.unassigned.count (5m) -> alert. Canary tonight 10:00pm PT. Change list: 
- reduce enrichment wait 10s -> 5s
- fallback path: assign to overflow pool + tag "needs-enrichment"
- add 0-500ms jitter on assignment attempts
- add metric & alert for unassigned leads >5m
- slack notify to #sales-ops on alert

maria (Marketing Ops): I’ll update the handoff playbook and add a short note to the SDR rota about the overflow tag and manual claim steps. Also will draft a quick customer-facing comms snippet in case anyone sees late outreach.

lee (Sales Eng): If canary is green, roll to prod at ~1:00am PT. @dev-bot please attach release notes and tag PRs.

dev-bot: noted — will annotate release with jira/PR links and add a release line for slack alerts.

sam (RevOps): Owners: lee -> implement patch & canary, sam -> monitor metrics & run smoke tests, maria -> comms + doc updates, ajay -> validate claim flow tomorrow AM. Meeting 9:30am PT if it persists. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
